directory.description: Directory to change into before scanning (equivalent to -d/--directory=...).

file.description: Path to digest file to check/update (equivalent to -f/--file=...).

type.description: Digest algorithm: md5, sha1, sha256, or sha512 (equivalent to -t/--type=...).

exclude_marker.description: Marker filename whose presence excludes directory from scan (equivalent to --exclude-marker=...).

modify_window.description: Tolerance in seconds for mtime differences (e.g., for FAT filesystems) (equivalent to --modify-window=...).

restrict.description: Substring filter for filepaths to include in scan (equivalent to --restrict=...).

check.description: Force full digest scan ignoring mtime/size (equivalent to -c/--check).

links.description: Follow symlinks instead of storing target path (equivalent to -l/--links).

update.description: Auto-update digest in batch mode (equivalent to -u/--update).

windows.description: Use 1-second mtime tolerance for FAT (equivalent to -w/--windows).
